title: Loop Preflight Report
description: Normalized JSON report written to stdout by loop-preflight. The Qt plugin consumes this shape only — never backend-specific payloads.

schema_kind.description: Machine-readable schema kind for compatibility routing.

schema_version.description: Report contract version. Version 1 required page and bbox on every finding. Version 2 adds explicit scope and optional location fields. Version 3 adds inspection_complete and per-check status reporting (checks[]). Decisions, digests, profile identity, coverage scope, and variable bindings are additive fields in version 3.

inspection_complete.description: False when at least one check could not run to completion (unknown check id, a check threw and was contained, or mandatory PDF/X evidence was unavailable) — pass is forced false in that case even if no error findings were recorded.

pass.description: Compatibility convenience value derived from verdict.state; it is true only for the pass verdict.

verdict.description: Canonical operator-facing reduction shared by Core, CLI, PageMaster, and the Editor.

profile.description: Profile name that produced this report (profile.name).

pdf.description: Optional path or basename of the checked PDF.

pdfx.description: Optional normalized PDF/X conformance result. Present only when the profile requested a PDF/X target.

profile_resolution.description: Optional deterministic profile selection and provenance record.

document_revision_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact PDF bytes inspected.

effective_profile_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the effective profile JSON used for this run.

profile_identity.description: Resolved profile identity. digest is the file digest; effective_digest is after restrictions and variable substitution.

coverage_scope.description: Coverage claim for this profile. A clean pass is clean against this scope, not a GWG conformance certificate.

variable_bindings.description: Variable values used for this run, including the winning binding source.

decisions.description: Operator decisions imported for, or recorded beside, this run. Decision state is derived against the current digests.

errors.description: Failing findings with severity error (or mapped to error).

fixups_available.description: Fixups the engine believes apply to this document given the profile. May be filtered dynamically by the engine; not necessarily identical to profile.fixups.

checks.description: Per-check outcome for every check listed in the profile, in profile order.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned box in PDF user space (points), page coordinates: [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1. Origin is the page media-box lower-left (PDF convention). Present only when the engine has a meaningful page-space region to highlight.

graph_backed_finding_type.description: Finding types emitted from Evidence Graph records; each must cite evidence_ids.

evidence_ids.description: Ids of Evidence Graph records this finding cites. Required for graph-backed finding types.

object_id.description: Optional PDF object / resource identifier when known (stringified). Null or omit when not applicable.

type.description: Machine-readable finding type (kebab-case), often matching a check id.

message.description: Human-readable description for the report panel.

check_id.description: Optional profile check id that produced this finding.

evidence.description: Optional structured evidence for deterministic diagnostics.

scope.description: document: no page location; page: page-level condition; object: page object or region when bbox/object_id are known.

page.description: Required for page and object scope. Absent for document scope.

object_id.description: Optional PDF object / resource identifier when known. Never substitutes for scope.

type.description: Machine-readable finding type (kebab-case), often matching a check id.

message.description: Human-readable description for the report panel.

check_id.description: Optional profile check id that produced this finding.

evidence.description: Optional structured evidence for deterministic diagnostics.

id.description: Profile check id this status refers to.

status.description: ok: no findings. warning: only warning/info findings. failed: at least one error finding, or the check threw and was contained. skipped: disabled in the profile or incomplete because a required inspection could not run within its budget. unsupported: unknown check id or unavailable mandatory PDF/X evidence.

reason.description: Present for skipped/unsupported/failed statuses; omitted for ok/warning.

safe.description: True only for fixups that do not change printed color/content in a material way. Most print fixups are safe: false.

params.description: Optional parameters for automated fixup invocation (e.g. mode for add-bleed).
